_comment: Every third-party artifact the Windows build downloads, pinned by URL +
sha256. build-windows.ps1 refuses a mismatching hash. To bump a dep:
update url/version, blank the sha256, run build-windows.ps1 -AcceptNewHashes
(it downloads, records the hash, and rewrites this file), then VERIFY the
new hash against the upstream project's published checksum before
committing. Rationale for each source lives in PACKAGING.md's dependency
kicad: NOT bundled. The official KiCad Windows installer is downloaded by
build-windows.ps1 only to be shipped ALONGSIDE the eSim installer (the
eSim installer offers to run it). Bundling a private KiCad copy is what
made the old off-repo installer unmaintainable.

python.notes: Full private CPython (nuget layout: tools/ = the runtime). Unlike the 'embeddable' zip, pip works normally, which is how the PyQt6 wheel set is installed.

ngspice.notes: Official 64-bit Windows build with XSPICE code models. Same version the Ubuntu nghdl toolchain builds from source.

iverilog.notes: Bleyer's Windows Icarus build. FALLBACK ONLY (-SkipSimBuild): it ships without libvvp, so d_cosim cannot run with it - only the Verilog Verifier. The Full build compiles iverilog_source instead. Extracted (7z), NOT run, staged under library/bin/iverilog/.

iverilog_source.notes: Icarus Verilog source at the SAME pinned commit nghdl/install-nghdl.sh builds on Ubuntu (ICARUS_REF). Built inside the staged MSYS2 (mingw64) with --enable-libvvp - the one piece d_cosim needs that no prebuilt Windows Icarus provides - and staged under library/bin/iverilog/.

msys2.notes: Base MSYS2, then pacman installs mingw-w64-x86_64-{gcc,make,verilator,ghdl-llvm} plus the msys build tools (autotools/bison/flex/gperf/patch/make) inside it (see build-windows.ps1). Powers the OPTIONAL 'HDL toolchain' installer component (NgVeri code-model builds + NGHDL/GHDL VHDL co-sim) AND hosts the Stage-SimToolchain source builds. ghdl-llvm, NEVER ghdl-mcode: mcode cannot link the nghdl socket server (GHDL-BACKEND-26.04.md applies on Windows too).

kicad_installer.notes: Shipped next to the eSim installer as a prerequisite; eSim's installer launches it if KiCad is absent. Never repacked.

innosetup.notes: Build-machine tool only (provides ISCC.exe); nothing from it ships inside the eSim installer. Hosted on GitHub releases -- jrsoftware pruned files.jrsoftware.org/is/6/ (older point releases 404 there).
